draftedFindings.title: first panics when n exceeds the slice length
draftedFindings.body: `&items[..n]` panics if callers request more elements than `items.len()`. The existing `last` helper handles the analogous case by returning all available items, so `first(&[1, 2], 3)` should likely do the same instead of crashing. Clamp the end index with `n.min(items.len())`.
